limitations: This is an assistant semantic review, not an independent human expert assessment.
Documents, users, facts and callbacks are synthetic local fixtures; approving false sources is an explicit evaluation setup rather than a demonstrated authorization bypass.
Repeated-content selection uses LocalEmbeddings and explicit synthetic source labels; it is not a production embedding-recall or general truth-resolution benchmark.
Two real tool-result cases had no cross-user proposal and did not exercise active policy rejection. Offline forced-proposal tests verify that boundary separately.
Raw results remain unchanged. Semantically reviewed fact ASR and normal QA results must be applied from these separate review records.
